name: Mathematics
description: Math minor: one Calculus II option plus 9 additional upper-level math hours.
notes: Select one of MATH 148/152/172, plus 9 hours from approved upper-level math list.

name: Statistics
description: Statistics minor: STAT 211 and STAT 212 required, plus three additional STAT electives from the approved list.
notes: Pick 3 STAT electives from the approved upper-level list after completing STAT 211 and STAT 212.

name: Business
description: Business minor: core set of accounting, management, finance, marketing, and IS courses.
notes: All of ACCT 209, MGMT 309, FINC 409, MKTG 409, ISTM 209, and MGMT 209 are required.

name: Game Design and Development
description: Game Design minor: CS foundations plus graphics/interactive systems and game design courses.
notes: Requires CSCE 110 and CSCE 111 or CSCE 120; CSCE 441 or VIST 386; CSCE 443 or VIST 487; plus 3 electives from COMM 230/JOUR 230, COMM 453, CSCE 436, VIST 370, VIST 374.
